metadata.purpose: Merge projected inner Observables while the most recent inner next updates the accumulator used at later admission.

cardinality.signature: mergeScan : (R × T × Index -> R*) × R × T* -> R*
conditions: Each projected inner may emit zero, one, many or indefinite accumulator values.
Each inner next updates the state before forwarding the same value downstream.
Concurrent projections receive the accumulator snapshot at their own admission. Overlap permits nondeterministic interleaving.
Bounded concurrency delays projection of queued values until a slot becomes free; completion waits for all accepted inner work.

scope.parameters: Seed is a provided opaque R reference; concurrency 2; valid Observable-returning accumulator.
scope.callbacks: One synchronous callback request carries {accumulator,value}, plus exact zero-based admission index; only correlated return/throw accepted.
scope.time: No clock or scheduler is created. Outer and inner sources supply time; same-time delivery order is explicit in the input sequence.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant reactions with synchronous projection outcomes. Exact teardown traces assume source initialization has returned before terminal events.
exclusions: Promise/Iterable return conversions, reentrant projections, observer or finalizer throws.
No promise of serial accumulation under concurrency greater than 1; this model intentionally admits stale snapshots across overlaps.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one outer subscription; no projection or inner subscription before an accepted outer value.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay introduced. Each result subscription owns its counter, active-inner bindings and queue; an inner producer may itself be shared.
ownership.reset: Each output subscription starts from the supplied seed reference. Latest inner output replaces accumulator by identity; no implicit cloning.

resources.owner: this result subscription; generation is its admission index
external projection binding; generation correlates the invocation

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret the ordered actions. A return is resolved before the next external input. Never replace RxJS delivery with an implicit event FIFO.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; release the outer if still open and all active inners; discard queued values without completing.
Outer completion is not cancellation of admitted or queued inner work.

rules.guard: fresh execution
rules.nextState: outer open with index zero and no active inners or queued values
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Subscription connects to the outer source. Pipeline construction alone starts no projection or inner execution.

rules.guard: a concurrency slot is available and the index can advance
actions: request one accumulator callback with the input and admission index
rules.nextState: one pending projection; index advanced once
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). An accepted outer value invokes the projection once with that value and the next zero-based admission index. The returned inner source is subscribed only after projection succeeds.

rules.guard: all concurrency slots are occupied
rules.nextState: append the raw outer value to the FIFO queue without changing the projection index
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). When all slots are occupied, retain the outer value in arrival order. Do not project it yet. A later inner completion admits the oldest queued value.

rules.guard: matching invocation with resume=Active
actions: subscribe the returned source under the pending invocation generation
rules.nextState: new inner admitted; no outer value emitted directly
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). A successful projection starts its inner subscription. The outer input itself is not forwarded; values come from the admitted inner.

rules.guard: matching invocation with resume=Draining
actions: subscribe the returned source under the pending invocation generation
rules.nextState: new inner admitted; no outer value emitted directly
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Queued outer values still get projected after outer completion. Their inner subscriptions must also finish before the result can complete.

rules.guard: matching projection invocation
actions: error downstream with the thrown value
release the open outer and every remaining inner; discard the queue
rules.nextState: closed by projection error
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). If projection throws, forward that error and tear down all owned subscriptions. Queued values are discarded without projection, and no completion follows.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Values from admitted active inners are forwarded unchanged in actual delivery order.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.nextState: closed by inner error
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). An active inner error ends the whole result, including the outer subscription and other active inners.

rules.guard: between resolved reactions
actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.nextState: closed by cancellation
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Downstream cancellation unsubscribes from the outer and every active inner. It neither completes the result nor projects queued values.

rules.guard: matching inner; queue nonempty; projection index can advance
actions: dequeue the oldest value and request its accumulator callback
rules.nextState: one slot reserved for the dequeued input; other inners remain active
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). When an inner completes, release it and admit the oldest queued value into the free slot. Its projection runs now, not when it originally arrived.

rules.guard: matching inner and empty queue
rules.nextState: remove that inner and keep waiting
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). An inner completing does not complete the result while the outer is still open. Wait for more outer values or other active inners.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). After the outer completes, values from remaining inners continue to flow until those inners finish.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.nextState: closed by inner error
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). An inner error while draining still ends the result immediately; other inner work and any queued values are discarded.

rules.guard: between resolved reactions
actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.nextState: closed by cancellation
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Cancellation while draining releases the remaining inners and discards queued work without completion.

rules.guard: matching inner; queue nonempty; projection index can advance
actions: dequeue the oldest value and request its accumulator callback
rules.nextState: one slot reserved for the dequeued input; other inners remain active
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Outer completion does not discard the queue. Continue admitting queued values as inner subscriptions finish.

rules.guard: matching inner, empty queue, and another inner remains
rules.nextState: remove that inner and keep waiting
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). When one of several remaining inners completes, keep waiting for the others.

rules.guard: matching final inner and empty queue
rules.nextState: closed by successful completion
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). The result completes only when the outer has completed and all admitted inner work, including any queue, is finished. The final cleanup order follows this operator family under the post-setup profile.

rules.guard: at least one active inner
rules.nextState: outer done; preserve active inners and queued values
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). Outer completion stops new arrivals but does not cancel the current inner work. Keep forwarding inner values and, where applicable, draining the queue.

rules.guard: no active inner and empty queue
rules.nextState: closed by successful completion
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). If the outer completes with no inner work left, complete immediately and release the outer subscription.

rules.guard: outer still open
actions: release the outer and active inners; discard the queue
rules.nextState: closed by outer error
rules.explanation: Accumulator snapshot for a new invocation is the latest inner next (or original seed). An outer error is forwarded immediately. Unlike completion, it cancels active inners and discards queued values.
